fields.label: Staff Number
fields.description: Optional alternate login: 2-6 digits, unique per tenant.

fields.label: PIN (set on a device - never shown)
fields.description: Write-only by design. A PIN is chosen by its owner on a staff-app device and hashed by the Hub; Desk can neither show nor set it. Use 'Request PIN reset' to let the person choose a new one.

fields.label: Pin Reset Requested At
fields.description: Ticket P4-34: set by request_pin_reset() (Back Office "Reset PIN"), cleared by push_pin_reset() once the person has set a new PIN themselves on a staff-app device — the Hub hashes it locally (it holds the pepper, Frappe never does), so this flag is the only thing that ever crosses the boundary in either direction, never a PIN or a hash-in-progress.

fields.label: Assignments
fields.description: One person, one PIN per tenant, with a role at each outlet they work in.
